title: narcissus minor subsp. brevicoronatus
intro: Narcissus minor subsp. brevicoronatus, commonly known as the Alpine Daffodil, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the Amaryllidaceae family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to reduce anxiety and stress, improve mood, and exhibit antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include alkaloids, such as galantamine and lycorine, as well as flavonoids and terpenoids, which have been shown to have neuroprotective and immunomodulatory effects.
